name: D.C. II ~Featuring Yun2!~
source: Sakura Yun, who witnessed the collapse of the world in [url=http://vndb.org/v78]Saishuu Shiken Kujira[/url], suddenly appeared on the Hatsune island. She fell from the sky, breaking the roof of Yoshiyuki's house. What will do the protagonist with such an unexpected guest?
translation: 在[url=http://vndb.org/v78]《最终试验鲸鱼》[/url]中目睹世界崩溃的咲仓优，突然出现在初音岛上。她从天而降，砸穿了樱内义之家屋顶。面对这位意料之外的访客，主人公将会怎么办？
